A raised model with a tray and harness keeps a young child securely positioned within reach of food during a meal.

items.sentence: Many designs combine a horizontal sitting surface with a raised backrest and four supporting legs.
The frame may be made from wood, metal, molded plastic, or combinations of these materials.
Upholstered versions place padding and fabric or leather over a rigid supporting frame.
Some models fold flat, while others swivel on a central post or adjust in height.
A person usually lowers their body onto the sitting surface and rests their back against the upright panel.
Lightweight versions can be lifted and moved between rooms without disassembly.
On gas-lift models, a user can operate a lever to raise or lower the sitting surface.
In folding designs, paired supports pivot inward, reducing the space needed for storage.
During meals, one is commonly positioned at each place around a dining table.
In classrooms, rows of these furnishings let students face an instructor or display.
Outdoor versions are often kept on patios, balconies, or beside campfires when weather permits.
Waiting areas frequently place several units along walls to accommodate visitors.
A single-person design provides a stable place to sit during meals, work, or conversation.
A backrest can support the torso and encourage a more upright seated posture.
Armrests give a resting surface for the forearms and can help someone rise.
In offices, adjustable models help users align their seating height with a desk.
